title: Pearl Fest 2026 – Celebrating Young Talent and Creativity at ICSK Junior
organizer: The Indian Community School Kuwait – Junior (ICSK Junior)
summary: A vibrant celebration of creativity, imagination and young talent at the Pearl Fest 2026 Award Ceremony, organized by The Indian Community School Kuwait – Junior. The occasion brought together students, educators and parents to recognize artistic achievements and inspire young minds, with Dr.Susovana Sujit Nair gracing the ceremony as Chief Guest.
description:
The Indian Community School Kuwait - Junior celebrated the creativity, imagination and remarkable talents of its young learners through Pearl Fest 2026, a colourful and inspiring award ceremony held on 31 October 2026 at ICSK Senior.

Organized under the beautiful theme “Art Inspires Creativity, Builds Tomorrow,” the occasion was a wonderful celebration of artistic expression, youthful enthusiasm and the extraordinary potential of young minds.

The ceremony was graced by Dr. Susovana Sujit Nair as Chief Guest, whose address encouraged the young achievers to nurture their creativity, believe in their abilities and pursue their dreams with confidence and determination.

The occasion was made particularly special by the gracious presence of the distinguished ICSK leadership, including Mr. Shaik Abdul Rahiman, Honorary Chairman; Mr. Azharuddin Amer Mohammed, Honorary Secretary; Dr. V. Binumon, Principal of ICSK Senior and Senior Administrator – ICSK; Mr. K. Gangadhar, Principal of ICSK Khaitan; and Mr. Rajesh Nair C., Principal of ICSK Amman.

Special appreciation and heartfelt thanks to Mrs. C. Sheeja, Principal of ICSK Junior, for her warm hospitality, thoughtful coordination and dedication to creating such a meaningful platform for the children to showcase their talents.

Sincere gratitude is also extended to the ICSK Board of Trustees, school leadership, dedicated teachers, organizing team and supportive parents, whose collective encouragement and commitment made the celebration truly memorable.

Beyond the awards and recognition, Pearl Fest beautifully reflected the school's commitment to holistic education, reminding everyone that every child possesses unique talents deserving of encouragement, appreciation and an opportunity to shine.

A heartwarming celebration of creativity, achievement and the boundless possibilities of young minds.

title: Visit to Kuwait Grand Mosque (Masjid Al-Kabir) – Building Bridges of Understanding
organizer: Indian Muslim Association (IMA) Ladies Wing, Kuwait
venue: Kuwait Grand Mosque (Masjid Al-Kabir), Kuwait City
summary: A meaningful cultural visit to Kuwait's Grand Mosque, thoughtfully organized by the Indian Muslim Association (IMA) Ladies Wing, bringing together people from diverse backgrounds to foster friendship, mutual respect and a deeper appreciation of Islamic heritage.
description:
The Indian Muslim Association (IMA) Ladies Wing, Kuwait, organized a special guided visit to the Kuwait Grand Mosque (Masjid Al-Kabir) on 23 October 2026, under the inspiring theme “Building Bridges of Understanding Through Faith, Culture and Friendship.”

The initiative brought together participants from diverse cultural and community backgrounds, creating a meaningful opportunity to experience Kuwait's rich Islamic heritage and learn about its traditions, values and architectural legacy.

The guided visit offered fascinating insights into the Grand Mosque's magnificent prayer halls, intricate Islamic calligraphy, elaborate geometric designs and remarkable craftsmanship. Beyond its architectural beauty, the experience encouraged dialogue, cultural appreciation and a greater understanding of the values of respect, compassion and peaceful coexistence.

The occasion reflected the Indian Muslim Association's commitment to fostering goodwill, strengthening relationships and promoting harmony among Kuwait's multicultural communities.

A memorable and enriching experience, the visit demonstrated how cultural exchange and shared learning can build lasting bridges of friendship and understanding across communities.

title: FID Kuwait – Official Handover Ceremony 2026–2028
summary: A significant occasion marking the official transition of the Forum of Indian Doctors Kuwait leadership for 2026–2028, including the reappointment of Dr. Susovana Sujit Nair as Vice-President for a second consecutive term.
description:
The Forum of Indian Doctors (FID) Kuwait held its Official Handover Ceremony on 2 October 2026 at Crowne Plaza, bringing together outgoing and incoming office bearers, executive committee members, past presidents and members of the medical fraternity.

The ceremony marked the formal transition from the 2024–2026 leadership team to the newly constituted committee for 2026–2028.

A particularly meaningful moment was the reappointment of Dr. Susovana Sujit Nair as Vice-President of the Forum of Indian Doctors (FID) Kuwait for the 2026–2028 term, marking the continuation of her leadership and service in the same capacity following her tenure during 2024–2026.

The occasion celebrated continuity in leadership, professional fellowship and a shared commitment to strengthening the Indian medical community in Kuwait.

title: A Distinguished Gathering in Honour of the Ambassador of India to Kuwait
organizer: M.M. Holding Company / Mughal Mahal Group
summary: A memorable welcome gathering hosted by M.M. Holding Company / Mughal Mahal Group in honour of H.E. Ms. Paramita Tripathi, Ambassador of India to Kuwait, and Mr. Pradyumn Kumar Tripathi, bringing together distinguished guests and members of the Indian community for warm interaction and fellowship.
description:
On 19 December 2025, the Executive Management, Partners and Family of M.M. Holding Company / Mughal Mahal Group hosted a special welcome breakfast and brunch in honour of H.E. Ms. Paramita Tripathi, Ambassador of India to Kuwait, and Mr. Pradyumn Kumar Tripathi.

The gathering brought together distinguished guests and members of the Indian community in an atmosphere of warmth, hospitality and mutual appreciation.

The occasion provided an opportunity for meaningful interaction with the Ambassador and fellow community members, including an address to the gathering that reflected the spirit of friendship, connection and shared community values.

A memorable occasion celebrating the importance of personal relationships, community engagement and the enduring bonds between India and Kuwait.
